The dominant month of a trading day is the month with the largest open interest on the previous day, and it only moves to later months. Signals use ratio back-adjusted prices; fills and profit use the real prices of the real contracts.

主力连续需要同一品种至少两个月份的 K 线，且每个月份都有日线数据。: A dominant series needs bars for at least two months of one product, each with daily data.
快均线高于慢均线时做多，低于时做空，相等时空仓。: Long while the fast average is above the slow one, short while it is below, flat when they are equal.
收盘价高于此前“入场通道”根 K 线的最高价时做多，低于其最低价时做空；收盘价反: Long from a close above the highest high of the Entry channel bars before it, short from one below their lowest low; flat when a close passes the opposite extreme of the Exit channel bars before it. The exit channel is no longer than the entry channel.
收盘价高于“动量回看”根 K 线之前的收盘价时做多，低于时做空，相等时空仓。: Long while the close is above the close Momentum lookback bars earlier, short while it is below, flat when they are equal.
收盘价高于最近“均值窗口”根收盘价的均值加“带宽”倍标准差时做空，低于均值减“带: Short from a close more than Band width standard deviations above the mean of the last Mean window closes, long from one as far below it; flat when a close returns to the mean.
窗口按已完成的 K 线根数计。做多或做空时持有目标手数，不允许的方向空仓；反手时: Windows count completed bars. A side holds the target lots and a side that is not allowed stays flat; a reversal closes first and opens on the bar after the close has filled.
在所有合约都有的 K 线上，每隔“调仓间隔”根按“收盘价 ÷ 动量回看根之前的收: On the bars every contract has, at every “Rebalance every”-th one the contracts are ranked by their close over the close “Momentum lookback” such bars earlier. The strongest “Contracts a side” are held long and the weakest short, the rest flat, until the next ranking. A held contract holds the lots whose value is nearest “Notional per contract”, by the close of the ranking bar and the contract multiplier. A dominant series counts as one contract. With “Volatility window” at 0 every held one holds the same notional; at N (2 or more) what they hold together stays the same and is split by the inverse of the standard deviation of each one's returns over the last N shared bars, so the more volatile holds less.
在所有品种都有期限结构的 K 线上，每隔“调仓间隔”根按最近“均值窗口”根 K: On the bars where every product has a term structure, at every “Rebalance every”-th one the products are ranked by the mean, over the last “Mean window” bars, of their annualised spread between the near and the later month. The highest “Contracts a side” (the near month dearest) are held long and the lowest short, the rest flat, until the next ranking. It is for dominant series only. A held product holds the lots whose value is nearest “Notional per contract”, by the close of the ranking bar and the contract multiplier. With “Volatility window” at 0 every held one holds the same notional; at N (2 or more) what they hold together stays the same and is split by the inverse of the standard deviation of each one's returns over the last N shared bars, so the more volatile holds less.
做多最高、做空最低: Long the highest, short the lowest
做多最低、做空最高: Long the lowest, short the highest
